export function estimateMemoryStability(history, maxScore = 100, baselineScore = null) {
  <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (!Array.isArray(history) || history.length === 0) <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >return 3;</span>
&nbsp;
  const sorted = [...history]
    .filter((h) =&gt; h?.date &amp;&amp; !Number.isNaN(new Date(h.date).getTime()))
    .sort((a, b) =&gt; new Date(a.date) - new Date(b.date));
&nbsp;
  <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (sorted.length === 0) <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >return 3;</span>
&nbsp;
  let stability = 3.0;
  const DECAY_FACTOR = 0.6;
  
  // O sucesso dinâmico é a própria média do aluno ou no mínimo 50% da prova.
  // Se o baseline não for passado, calcula a média do próprio history
  const safeBaseline = baselineScore !== null ? <span class="branch-0 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >baselineScore </span>: _mean(sorted.map(h =&gt; getSafeScore(h, maxScore)));
  const dynamicSuccessThreshold = Math.max(0.5, safeBaseline / maxScore);
&nbsp;
  for (let i = 0; i &lt; sorted.length; i++) {
    const h = sorted[i];
    const pct = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, getSafeScore(h, maxScore) / maxScore));
&nbsp;
    // Calcula quanto tempo passou desde a última revisão para saber a retenção atual
    let currentRetention = 1.0;
    if (i &gt; 0) {
      const gap = (new Date(h.date) - new Date(sorted[i - 1].date)) / 86400000;
      currentRetention = computeEbbinghausRetention(gap, stability);
    }
&nbsp;
    if (pct &gt;= dynamicSuccessThreshold) {
      // Crescimento Elástico: Se a retenção estava em 30%, o fator é ~2.7x (reforço forte). 
      // Se a retenção estava em 95%, o fator é ~1.1x (ganho marginal).
      const elasticGrowth = 1 + (1.5 * Math.exp(-currentRetention));
      stability *= elasticGrowth;
    } else {
      stability *= DECAY_FACTOR;
      stability = Math.max(1, stability);
    }
&nbsp;
    if (i &lt; sorted.length - 1) {
      const gap = (new Date(sorted[i + 1].date) - new Date(sorted[i].date)) / 86400000;
      const retention = computeEbbinghausRetention(gap, stability);
      stability *= (0.7 + 0.3 * retention);
    }
&nbsp;
    stability = Math.min(180, Math.max(1, stability));
  }
&nbsp;
  return Number(stability.toFixed(1));
}

export function computeOptimalReviewInterval(stability, targetRetention = 0.7, mssdVolatility = null, effectiveN = null, maxScore = 100, currentMean = null) {
  const S = Math.max(0.5, Number(stability) || <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >7)</span>;
  const R = Math.max(0.05, Math.min(0.99, Number(targetRetention) || <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >0.7)</span>);

  if (mssdVolatility !== null &amp;&amp; effectiveN !== null) {
      // Normaliza o MSSD para uma escala de 0 a 1

      // 1. Fator de Fragilidade (Conhecimento Frágil)

&nbsp;
      // 2. Fator de Cristalização (Domínio Consolidado)

export function computeForgettingRisk(history, maxScore = 100, baselineScore = null, mssdVolatility = null, effectiveN = null) {

<span class="cline-any cline-neutral">&nbsp;</span></td><td class="text"><pre class="prettyprint lang-js">/**
 * Percentile bootstrap CI for robust uncertainty estimation.
 * Useful when normality assumptions are weak.
 */
export function bootstrapCI(samples, statFn, {
  iterations = 1000,
  alpha = 0.05,
  seed = 42,
} = {}) {
  const clean = (samples || []).map(Number).filter(Number.isFinite);
  if (clean.length === 0) return { estimate: 0, low: 0, high: 0, n: 0 };
&nbsp;
  const estimate = Number(statFn(clean));
  const iters = Math.max(200, Math.floor(iterations));
  const a = Math.min(0.49, Math.max(0.001, alpha / 2));
&nbsp;
  let s = seed &gt;&gt;&gt; 0;
  const rand = () =&gt; {
    s = (1664525 * s + 1013904223) &gt;&gt;&gt; 0;
    return s / 4294967296;
  };
&nbsp;
  const dist = new Array(iters);
  const n = clean.length;
  for (let i = 0; i &lt; iters; i++) {
    const bag = new Array(n);
    for (let j = 0; j &lt; n; j++) {
      bag[j] = clean[Math.floor(rand() * n)];
    }
    const v = Number(statFn(bag));
    dist[i] = Number.isFinite(v) ? v : estimate;
  }
&nbsp;
  dist.sort((x, y) =&gt; x - y);
  const q = (p) =&gt; {
    const idx = (dist.length - 1) * p;
    const lo = Math.floor(idx);
    const hi = Math.ceil(idx);
    if (lo === hi) return dist[lo];
    const w = idx - lo;
    return dist[lo] * (1 - w) + dist[hi] * w;
  };
&nbsp;
  return {
    estimate,
    low: q(a),
    high: q(1 - a),
    n,
  };
}
&nbsp;</pre></td></tr></table></pre>

import { getPercentile } from './percentile.js';
&nbsp;
/**
 * Abramowitz &amp; Stegun approximation (formula 7.1.26) for Normal(0,1) CDF
 * Returns 1 - P(X &lt;= z)
 */
export function normalCDF_complement(z) {
    // MATH-02 FIX: Clamp extreme z-scores. The Abramowitz &amp; Stegun polynomial
    // loses precision for |z| &gt; 6 and can return slightly negative values for |z| &gt; 8.
    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (z === Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY) <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >return 0;</span>
    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (z === Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY) <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >return 1;</span>
    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (Number.isNaN(z)) <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >return 0.5;</span>
    if (z &gt; 8) return 0;
    if (z &lt; -8) return 1;
    const t = 1 / (1 + 0.2316419 * Math.abs(z));
    const d = 0.3989423 * Math.exp(-z * z / 2);
    let p = d * t * (0.3193815 + t * (-0.3565638 + t * (1.781478 + t * (-1.821256 + t * 1.330274))));
    return z &gt; 0 ? p : 1 - p;
}
&nbsp;
/**
 * Calculates Y value for an asymmetric Gaussian curve
 */
export function asymmetricGaussian(x, mean, sdLeft, sdRight, heightFactor = 1) {
    const rawSd = x &lt; mean ? sdLeft : sdRight;
    // Previne divisão por zero se sdLeft/sdRight vierem corrompidos
    const currentSd = Number.isFinite(rawSd) &amp;&amp; rawSd &gt; 0 ? rawSd : 1e-6;
    return heightFactor * Math.exp(-0.5 * Math.pow((x - mean) / currentSd, 2));
}
&nbsp;
/**
 * Generates SVG path points for a Gaussian curve
 */
export function generateGaussianPoints(xMin, xMax, steps, mean, sdLeft, sdRight, heightFactor, xp, yp) {
    const points = [];
    const safeXp = typeof xp === 'function' ? xp : <span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" ><span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >(v</span>) =&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >v;</span></span>
    const safeYp = typeof yp === 'function' ? yp : <span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" ><span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >(v</span>) =&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >v;</span></span>
    const safeSteps = Number.isFinite(steps) ? Math.max(1, Math.floor(steps)) : <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >1;</span>
    const stepSize = (xMax - xMin) / safeSteps;
&nbsp;
    for (let i = 0; i &lt;= safeSteps; i++) {
        const x = xMin + stepSize * i;
        const y = asymmetricGaussian(x, mean, sdLeft, sdRight, heightFactor);
        points.push({ x, y });
    }
&nbsp;
    // Ensure the mean (peak) is precisely included
    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="else path not taken" >E</span>if (mean &gt;= xMin &amp;&amp; mean &lt;= xMax) {
        points.push({ x: mean, y: asymmetricGaussian(mean, mean, sdLeft, sdRight, heightFactor) });
    }
&nbsp;
    // Sort to maintain chronological path order
    return points
        .sort((a, b) =&gt; a.x - b.x)
        .map(p =&gt; `${safeXp(p.x)},${safeYp(p.y)}`);
}
&nbsp;
/**
 * Fast Kernel Density Estimation (KDE) using Binning for large Monte Carlo samples.
 * Returns normalized density points (x, y) for SVG plotting.
 */
/**
 * @param {Float32Array} allScores - sorted simulation output scores
 * @param {number} projectedMean
 * @param {number} projectedSD
 * @param {number} safeSimulations
 * @param {number} [minScore=0]  - Dynamic lower bound (e.g. 0 pts)
 * @param {number} [maxScore=100] - Dynamic upper bound (e.g. 150 pts)
 */
export function generateKDE(allScores, projectedMean, projectedSD, safeSimulations, minScore = 0, maxScore = 100) {
    if (!allScores || allScores.length === 0) return [];
&nbsp;
    // FIX VISUAL: Margem dinâmica inteligente que respeita tanto a amplitude
    // do gráfico quanto o desvio padrão, com um piso mínimo (1.0).
    const slack = Math.max(maxScore * 0.05, projectedSD * 0.5, 1.0);
    let plotMin = Math.max(minScore - slack, projectedMean - 3.5 * projectedSD);
    let plotMax = Math.min(maxScore + slack, projectedMean + 3.5 * projectedSD);
&nbsp;
    const vMin = minScore - slack;
    const vMax = maxScore + slack;
&nbsp;
    // BUG 4 FIX: Ensure a minimum plot width of 1.0 even at domain boundaries.
    if (plotMax - plotMin &lt; 1) {
        plotMin = Math.max(vMin, projectedMean - 0.5);
        plotMax = Math.min(vMax, projectedMean + 0.5);
&nbsp;
        // Correct asymmetric squeeze at boundaries respeitando a folga visual
        if (plotMax &gt;= maxScore &amp;&amp; maxScore - minScore &gt;= 1) plotMin = Math.max(vMin, vMax - 1);
        <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (plotMin &lt;= minScore &amp;&amp; <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >maxScore - minScore &gt;= 1)</span> <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >plotMax = Math.min(vMax, vMin + 1);</span>
    }
&nbsp;
    const plotSteps = 200; // Aumento de resolução visual
    const stepSize = (plotMax - plotMin) / plotSteps;
&nbsp;
    // Silverman's Rule of Thumb para suavização ideal do Kernel
    const safeSimCount = Number.isFinite(safeSimulations) &amp;&amp; safeSimulations &gt; 0
        ? safeSimulations
        : <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >Math.max(1, allScores.length);</span>
    const iqr = getPercentile(allScores, 0.75) - getPercentile(allScores, 0.25);
    const scottFactor = iqr &gt; 0 ? Math.min(projectedSD, iqr / 1.34) : projectedSD;
    const h = 0.9 * scottFactor * Math.pow(safeSimCount, -0.2);
&nbsp;
    // REVISION: KDE using 300 Bins for higher UI resolution
    const BIN_COUNT = 300;
    const binWidth = (plotMax - plotMin) / BIN_COUNT;
&nbsp;
    // CORREÇÃO: Cálculo dinâmico do bandwidth sem o limite rígido de 1.0.
    // Isso evita que escalas maiores (ex: 0-1000) colapsem a resolução do KDE.
    const finiteH = Number.isFinite(h) &amp;&amp; h &gt; 0 ? h : <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >0;</span>
    const finiteProjectedSD = Number.isFinite(projectedSD) &amp;&amp; projectedSD &gt; 0 ? projectedSD : <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >0;</span>
    
    // Garantir que a banda do kernel abranja sempre pelo menos 3 bins físicos (suavização forçada)
    const minPhysicalBandwidth = (plotMax - plotMin) / (BIN_COUNT / 3); 
    const bandwidth = Math.max(minPhysicalBandwidth, finiteH, binWidth * 2, finiteProjectedSD * 0.15);
    const bins = new Float32Array(BIN_COUNT);
&nbsp;
    // BUG-KDE-01 FIX: usar allScores.length para evitar acesso OOB se safeSimulations != allScores.length
    for (let i = 0; i &lt; allScores.length; i++) {
        let s = Math.max(minScore, Math.min(maxScore, allScores[i]));
        if (s &gt; plotMax || s &lt; plotMin) continue;
        const idx = Math.min(BIN_COUNT - 1, Math.floor((s - plotMin) / binWidth));
        bins[idx]++;
    }
&nbsp;
    const invBandwidth = 1 / bandwidth;
&nbsp;
&nbsp;
&nbsp;
    // FIX MATEMÁTICO: A normalização usa a base total de simulações para 
    // evitar inflar o pico visual quando há muitos outliers fora da tela.
    // FIX: Adicionar proteção contra divisão por zero e underflow
    const normFactor = 1 / (Math.max(1, safeSimCount) * Math.max(1e-10, bandwidth) * Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI));
&nbsp;
    let maxY = 0;
    const rawData = [];
&nbsp;
    // FASE 1: Calcular densidades brutas
    for (let i = 0; i &lt;= plotSteps; i++) {
        const x = plotMin + i * stepSize;
        let density = 0;
&nbsp;
        for (let j = 0; j &lt; BIN_COUNT; j++) {
            if (bins[j] === 0) continue;
            const binX = plotMin + (j + 0.5) * binWidth;
&nbsp;
            const dist = (x - binX) * invBandwidth;
            const distReflMin = (x - (2 * minScore - binX)) * invBandwidth;
            const distReflMax = (x - (2 * maxScore - binX)) * invBandwidth;
&nbsp;
            if (Math.abs(dist) &lt; 4.0 || Math.abs(distReflMin) &lt; 4.0 || Math.abs(distReflMax) &lt; 4.0) {
                let localDensity = Math.exp(-0.5 * dist * dist);
                localDensity += Math.exp(-0.5 * distReflMin * distReflMin);
                localDensity += Math.exp(-0.5 * distReflMax * distReflMax);
                density += bins[j] * localDensity;
            }
        }
        density *= normFactor;
&nbsp;
        // FIX BUG 5: Remover o Hard-Cut da densidade.
        // O algoritmo Silverman's Reflection Kernel já cuida de não deixar a densidade vazar 
        // mantendo a integral igual a 1. Forçar a zero destrói a suavização vetorial (SVG) do UI.
        // REMOVIDO: if (x &lt; minScore || x &gt; maxScore) density = 0;
&nbsp;
        if (density &gt; maxY) maxY = density;
        rawData.push({ x, density });
    }
&nbsp;
    // BUGFIX B5: Normalizar integral da densidade para 1.0 (Reflexão de fronteira infla a integral)
    const totalArea = rawData.reduce((s, d, i) =&gt;
        i &gt; 0 ? s + (d.density + rawData[i - 1].density) * stepSize / 2 : s, 0);
    const normFactor2 = totalArea &gt; 0 ? 1 / totalArea : 1;
&nbsp;
    // FASE 2: Formatar (y: 0-1 para visualização, density: área=1 para probabilidades)
    return rawData.map(d =&gt; ({
        x: Number(d.x.toFixed(2)),
        y: maxY &gt; 1e-15 ? Number((d.density / maxY).toFixed(4)) : 0, // Proteção contra maxY zero
        density: d.density * normFactor2
    }));
}
&nbsp;
/**
 * Inversa da CDF Normal (Função Probit)
 * Método: Aproximação Racional de Beasley-Springer-Moro
 * Converte uma probabilidade (p entre 0 e 1) de volta para um Z-score na curva de Gauss.
 */
export function inverseNormalCDF(p) {
    if (p &lt;= 0) return -8; // Limite estatístico prático inferior
    if (p &gt;= 1) return 8;  // Limite estatístico prático superior
&nbsp;
    const a = [2.50662823884, -18.61500062529, 41.39119773534, -25.44106049637];
    const b = [-8.47351093090, 23.08336743743, -21.06224101826, 3.13082909833];
    const c = [0.3374754822726147, 0.9761690190917186, 0.1607979714918209,
        0.0276438810333863, 0.0038405729373609, 0.0003951896511919,
        0.0000321767881768, 0.0000002888167364, 0.0000003960315187];
&nbsp;
    let x = p - 0.5;
    if (Math.abs(x) &lt; 0.42) {
        let r = x * x;
        return x * (((a[3] * r + a[2]) * r + a[1]) * r + a[0]) /
            ((((b[3] * r + b[2]) * r + b[1]) * r + b[0]) * r + 1.0);
    } else {
        let r = p;
        if (x &gt; 0) r = 1.0 - p;
        r = Math.log(-Math.log(r));
        let z = c[0] + r * (c[1] + r * (c[2] + r * (c[3] + r * (c[4] + r * (c[5] + r * (c[6] + r * (c[7] + r * c[8])))))));
        return x &lt; 0 ? -z : z;
    }
}
&nbsp;
/**
 * Amostragem Estrita para Normal Truncada
 * Garante números exclusivamente entre [min, max] mantendo a suavidade da curva.
 */
export function sampleTruncatedNormal(mean, sd, min, max, rng) {
    // 1. NOVA PROTEÇÃO: Rejeitar dados não finitos para evitar corrupção do Monte Carlo
    if (!Number.isFinite(mean) || !Number.isFinite(sd) || !Number.isFinite(min) || !Number.isFinite(max)) {
        const lo = Number.isFinite(min) ? min : 0;
        const hi = Number.isFinite(max) ? max : <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >lo;</span>
        return Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, (lo + hi) / 2));
    }
&nbsp;
    // 2. NOVA PROTEÇÃO: Swap se min for maior que max
    if (min &gt; max) {
        const temp = min;
        min = max;
        max = temp;
    }
&nbsp;
    if (sd &lt;= 0.0001) return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, mean));
&nbsp;
    // O normalCDF_complement calcula P(X &gt;= z), logo 1 - normalCDF_complement = P(X &lt;= z)
    const cdfMin = 1 - normalCDF_complement((min - mean) / sd);
    const cdfMax = 1 - normalCDF_complement((max - mean) / sd);
&nbsp;
    // BUG 4 FIX: Underflow de Precisão.
    // Se o SD é muito baixo e o mean está longe da janela, cdfMax - cdfMin pode ser 0.
    const diff = cdfMax - cdfMin;
    if (diff &lt; 1e-16) {
        // Se a probabilidade acumulada é nula, retornamos o ponto mais provável no intervalo.
        return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, mean));
    }
&nbsp;
    // 3. NOVA PROTEÇÃO: STRICT DETERMINISM - Falha imediatamente se não houver RNG determinístico
    if (typeof rng !== 'function') {
        throw new Error('STRICT_DETERMINISM: Deterministic RNG required. Fallback to Math.random() is forbidden.');
    }
    const sampledU = rng();
    const u = Number.isFinite(sampledU) ? sampledU : <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >rng();</span>
    const p = cdfMin + u * diff;
&nbsp;
    const zScore = inverseNormalCDF(p);
    const rawScore = mean + (zScore * sd);
&nbsp;
    // FIX NUMÉRICO: Clamp garantindo que o retorno jamais quebre os bounds por erro do IEEE 754
    return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, rawScore));
}
&nbsp;
/**
 * 💡 Decomposição de Cholesky (A = L * L^T)
 * Converte um array de ruídos normais independentes em ruídos correlacionados.
 */
export function choleskyDecomposition(matrix) {
    const n = matrix.length;
    const lower = Array(n).fill(0).map(() =&gt; Array(n).fill(0));
&nbsp;
    for (let i = 0; i &lt; n; i++) {
        for (let j = 0; j &lt;= i; j++) {
            let sum = 0;
            if (j === i) {
                for (let k = 0; k &lt; j; k++) sum += Math.pow(lower[j][k], 2);
                lower[j][j] = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, matrix[j][j] - sum));
            } else {
                for (let k = 0; k &lt; j; k++) <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >sum += (lower[i][k] * lower[j][k]);</span>
                // Se a diagonal for 0, previne divisão por zero
                lower[i][j] = lower[j][j] &gt; 0 ? (matrix[i][j] - sum) / lower[j][j] : <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >0;</span>
            }
        }
    }
    return lower;
}
&nbsp;
/**
 * 💡 Aplica a matriz inferior L por um vetor de ruídos Z do Monte Carlo
 * Ex: Pega um choque neutro da sorte diária e espalha ele respeitando 
 * a correlação entre as disciplinas.
 */
export function applyCovariance(choleskyLower, zVector) {
    const n = zVector.length;
    const result = Array(n).fill(0);
    for (let i = 0; i &lt; n; i++) {
        for (let j = 0; j &lt;= i; j++) {
            result[i] += choleskyLower[i][j] * zVector[j];
        }
    }
    return result;
}

// SHARED STATISTICAL UTILITIES

&nbsp;
/**
 * Linear interpolation percentile calculator.
 * B1 FIX: Shared between simulateNormalDistribution (monteCarlo.js) and
 * monteCarloSimulation (projection.js) for consistent CI percentile calculation.
 * 
 * @param {Float64Array|Float32Array|number[]} arr - Sorted array of values
 * @param {number} p - Percentile (0 to 1, e.g. 0.025 for 2.5th percentile)
 * @returns {number} Interpolated percentile value
 */
export const getPercentile = (arr, p) =&gt; {
    if (!arr || arr.length === 0) return 0;
&nbsp;
    // BUG-7 FIX: Fast path para TypedArrays (Monte Carlo output) já ordenados.
    // Evita cópia O(n) + re-sort O(n log n) desnecessários por chamada.
    let sorted;
    if (arr instanceof Float64Array || arr instanceof Float32Array) {
        // Typed arrays do Monte Carlo são pre-sorted antes das chamadas a getPercentile
        sorted = arr;
    } else {
        const finite = Array.from(arr).filter(v =&gt; Number.isFinite(v));
        if (finite.length === 0) return 0;
        sorted = [...finite].sort((a, b) =&gt; a - b);
    }
&nbsp;
    // NOVAS PROTEÇÕES
    if (!Number.isFinite(p)) return 0;
    if (p &lt;= 0) return sorted[0]; // Retorna primeiro elemento se percentil &lt;= 0
    if (p &gt;= 1) return sorted[sorted.length - 1]; // Retorna último elemento se percentil &gt;= 1
    
    const idx = (sorted.length - 1) * p;
    const lower = Math.floor(idx);
    const upper = Math.ceil(idx);
    if (lower === upper) return sorted[lower];
    const weight = idx - lower;
    return sorted[lower] * (1 - weight) + sorted[upper] * weight;
};

<span class="cline-any cline-neutral">&nbsp;</span></td><td class="text"><pre class="prettyprint lang-js">import { mulberry32 } from './random.js';
import { normalCDF_complement, generateKDE, sampleTruncatedNormal } from './math/gaussian.js';
import { monteCarloSimulation } from './projection.js';
export { monteCarloSimulation };
import { getPercentile } from './math/percentile.js';
&nbsp;
export { getPercentile };
&nbsp;
const DEFAULT_SIMULATIONS = 5000;
const MAX_SIMULATIONS = 50000;
const DEFAULT_DOMAIN_MIN = 0;
const DEFAULT_DOMAIN_MAX = 100;
&nbsp;
function toFiniteNumber(value, fallback = 0) {
    const num = Number(value);
    return Number.isFinite(num) ? num : <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >fallback;</span>
}
&nbsp;
function clamp(value, min, max) {
    return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, value));
}
&nbsp;
function sanitizeDomain(minScore, maxScore) {
    const rawMin = toFiniteNumber(minScore, DEFAULT_DOMAIN_MIN);
    const rawMax = toFiniteNumber(maxScore, DEFAULT_DOMAIN_MAX);
    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="else path not taken" >E</span>if (rawMin &lt;= rawMax) {
        return { minScore: rawMin, maxScore: rawMax };
    }
    // Auto-correct invalid domain (min &gt; max) to preserve resilience.
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return { minScore: rawMax, maxScore: rawMin };</span>
}
&nbsp;
function sanitizeSimulations(simulations) {
    // DOS GUARD: evita consumo extremo de CPU com entradas hostis/acidentais.
    const normalized = Math.floor(toFiniteNumber(simulations, DEFAULT_SIMULATIONS));
    return clamp(normalized, 1, MAX_SIMULATIONS);
}
&nbsp;
// CORREÇÃO VISUAL E MATEMÁTICA: Geração de semente estável (FNV-1a Hash)
// Ancoramos a semente na volumetria e topologia do histórico, não na flutuação da média.
function generateStableSeed(historyCount, categoryName, targetScore) {
    let h = 2166136261; // Offset base FNV
    const seedStr = `${historyCount}-${String(categoryName || 'global')}-${Math.floor(targetScore || <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >0)</span>}`;
    
    for(let i = 0; i &lt; seedStr.length; i++) {
        h ^= seedStr.charCodeAt(i);
        h = Math.imul(h, 16777619); // Primo FNV
    }
    return h &gt;&gt;&gt; 0;
}
&nbsp;
export function simulateNormalDistribution(meanOrObj, sd, targetScore, simulations, seed, currentMean, categoryName, bayesianCI, historyLength = 0) {
    let mean = typeof meanOrObj === 'number' ? <span class="branch-0 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >meanOrObj </span>: 0;
    let minScore = DEFAULT_DOMAIN_MIN;
    let maxScore = DEFAULT_DOMAIN_MAX;
&nbsp;
    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="else path not taken" >E</span>if (typeof meanOrObj === 'object' &amp;&amp; meanOrObj !== null) {
        mean = meanOrObj.mean ?? <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >mean;</span>
        sd = meanOrObj.sd ?? <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >sd;</span>
        targetScore = meanOrObj.targetScore ?? <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >targetScore;</span>
        simulations = meanOrObj.simulations ?? <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >simulations;</span>
        seed = meanOrObj.seed ?? seed;
        currentMean = meanOrObj.currentMean ?? currentMean;
        categoryName = meanOrObj.categoryName ?? categoryName;
        bayesianCI = meanOrObj.bayesianCI ?? bayesianCI;
        minScore = meanOrObj.minScore ?? <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >minScore;</span>
        maxScore = meanOrObj.maxScore ?? <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >maxScore;</span>
        historyLength = meanOrObj.historyLength ?? 0;
    }
&nbsp;
    const safeDomain = sanitizeDomain(minScore, maxScore);
    minScore = safeDomain.minScore;
    maxScore = safeDomain.maxScore;
&nbsp;
    const safeMean = Number.isFinite(mean) ? mean : <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >0;</span>
    let safeSD = Number.isFinite(sd) &amp;&amp; sd &gt; 0 ? sd : <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >0; </span>
&nbsp;
    // FIX: Unificar a inferência do SD nos dois caminhos
    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (bayesianCI) {
        // SD SQUASH (Fix): Usar os limites NÃO truncados para inferir o SD real.
        // Se usarmos ciHigh truncado em 100, o SD será subestimado para alunos de elite.
        const high = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >bayesianCI.unclampedHigh !== undefined ? bayesianCI.unclampedHigh : bayesianCI.ciHigh;</span>
        const low = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >bayesianCI.unclampedLow !== undefined ? bayesianCI.unclampedLow : bayesianCI.ciLow;</span>
        
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        if (high !== undefined &amp;&amp; low !== undefined) {</span>
            let inferredSD = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >(high - low) / 3.92;</span>
            const distToBoundary = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >Math.min(safeMean - minScore, maxScore - safeMean);</span>
&nbsp;
            // Se a média estiver muito próxima do limite (0 ou 100), o intervalo de 95% 
            // fica comprimido. Inflamos o SD para refletir a incerteza real.
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            if (distToBoundary &lt; inferredSD * 1.5) {</span>
                const correctionFactor = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >1 + (1 - distToBoundary / (inferredSD * 1.5));</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >                inferredSD *= Math.min(1.5, correctionFactor);</span>
            }
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            if (Number.isFinite(inferredSD) &amp;&amp; inferredSD &gt; 0) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >                safeSD = inferredSD;</span>
            }
        }
    }
    // MATH-05/10 FIX: Use same effective target for empirical and analytic
    // Clamp target to simulation domain
    const effectiveTarget = Math.max(minScore, Math.min(maxScore, targetScore));
&nbsp;
    const safeSimulations = sanitizeSimulations(simulations);
&nbsp;
    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (safeSD &lt; 1e-5) {
        const prob = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >safeMean &gt;= effectiveTarget ? 100 : 0;</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        return {</span>
            simulationCount: safeSimulations,
            probability: prob,
            analyticalProbability: prob,
            recommendedProbability: prob,
            probabilityPolicy: 'deterministic',
            mean: Number(safeMean.toFixed(2)),
            sd: 0,
            sdVisual: 0,
            sdLeft: 0, 
            sdRight: 0, 
            ci95StatLow: Number(safeMean.toFixed(2)),
            ci95StatHigh: Number(safeMean.toFixed(2)),
            ci95Low: Number(safeMean.toFixed(2)),
            ci95High: Number(safeMean.toFixed(2)),
            ci95VisualLow: Number(safeMean.toFixed(2)),
            ci95VisualHigh: Number(safeMean.toFixed(2)),
            ci95VisualClamped: false,
            currentMean: Number((currentMean || safeMean).toFixed(2)),
            projectedMean: safeMean,
            projectedSD: 0,
            kdeData: [
                safeMean &gt; minScore ? { x: safeMean - 0.1, y: 0 } : null,
                { x: safeMean, y: 1 },
                safeMean &lt; maxScore ? { x: safeMean + 0.1, y: 0 } : null
            ].filter(Boolean), 
            drift: 0,
            volatility: 0,
            minScore,
            maxScore,
            method: bayesianCI ? 'bayesian_static_hybrid' : 'deterministic'
        };
    }
&nbsp;
    // SUBSTITUIÇÃO DA LÓGICA DE SEMENTE ANTIGA:
    // Remover o hash fraco (Math.floor(safeMean * 10000)) que causava o layout shift.

// Helper: Ensure history is sorted by date and filter out invalid dates
export function getSortedHistory(history) {
    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (!Array.isArray(history)) <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >return [];</span>
    return [...history]
        .filter(h =&gt; h &amp;&amp; (h.date || <span class="branch-2 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >h.createdAt)</span> &amp;&amp; !isNaN(new Date(h.date || <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >h.createdAt)</span>.getTime()))
        .sort((a, b) =&gt; {
            const dateA = new Date(a.date || <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >a.createdAt)</span>;
            const dateB = new Date(b.date || <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >b.createdAt)</span>;
            // Ordenação determinística por "dia UTC" para evitar variação por timezone do runtime.
            const utcA = Date.UTC(dateA.getUTCFullYear(), dateA.getUTCMonth(), dateA.getUTCDate());
            const utcB = Date.UTC(dateB.getUTCFullYear(), dateB.getUTCMonth(), dateB.getUTCDate());
            <span class="missing-if-branch" title="else path not taken" >E</span>if (utcA !== utcB) return utcA - utcB;
            // Desempate determinístico intra-dia para evitar depender da estabilidade do sort do runtime.
            const diff = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >dateA.getTime() - dateB.getTime();</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            if (diff !== 0) <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >return diff;</span></span>
            // Desempate determinístico final por ID (Bug 15)
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >            return (a.id || "").localeCompare(b.id || <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >"")</span>;</span>
        });
}

// -----------------------------
// Regressão ponderada temporal
// -----------------------------
export function weightedRegression(history, lambda = 0.08, maxScore = 100, options = {}) {
    const sorted = getSortedHistory(history);
    if (sorted.length &lt; 2) return { slope: 0, intercept: 0, slopeStdError: 1.5 };
&nbsp;
    const now = options.referenceDate || Date.now();
    let sumW = 0, sumWX = 0, sumWY = 0, sumWXX = 0, sumWXY = 0;
&nbsp;
    sorted.forEach(h =&gt; {
        const hDate = h.date || <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >h.createdAt;</span>
        const t = (now - new Date(hDate).getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
        const w = Math.exp(-lambda * t);
        const x = (new Date(hDate).getTime() - new Date(sorted[0].date || <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >sorted[0].createdAt)</span>.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
        const y = getSafeScore(h, maxScore);
&nbsp;
        sumW += w;
        sumWX += w * x;
        sumWY += w * y;
        sumWXX += w * x * x;
        sumWXY += w * x * y;
    });
&nbsp;
    const det = sumW * sumWXX - sumWX * sumWX;
    if (Math.abs(det) &lt; 1e-6) return { slope: 0, intercept: sumWY / sumW, slopeStdError: 1.5 };
&nbsp;
    const slope = (sumW * sumWXY - sumWX * sumWY) / det;
    const intercept = (sumWXX * sumWY - sumWX * sumWXY) / det;
&nbsp;
    // Erro padrão robusto (ajustado para small samples)
    const slopeStdError = calculateSlopeStdError(sorted, slope, intercept, lambda, maxScore, options);
&nbsp;
    return { slope, intercept, slopeStdError };
}
&nbsp;
function calculateSlopeStdError(sorted, slope, intercept, lambda, maxScore, options = {}) {
    const now = options.referenceDate || Date.now();
    const t0 = new Date(sorted[0].date || <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >sorted[0].createdAt)</span>.getTime();
    let rss = 0, sumW = 0, sumWXX = 0, sumWX = 0, sumW2 = 0;
&nbsp;
    sorted.forEach(h =&gt; {
        const hDate = h.date || <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >h.createdAt;</span>
        const x = (new Date(hDate).getTime() - t0) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
        const y = getSafeScore(h, maxScore);
        const w = Math.exp(-lambda * (now - new Date(hDate).getTime()) / 86400000);
        const pred = intercept + slope * x;
        rss += w * Math.pow(y - pred, 2);
        sumW += w;
        sumW2 += w * w;
        sumWX += w * x;
        sumWXX += w * x * x;
    });
&nbsp;
    // FIX: Usar o Tamanho Efetivo da Amostra de Kish para o divisor em WLS (Bug 16 / Lint Fix)
    const effectiveN = (sumW * sumW) / sumW2;
    const scaleFactorFallback = maxScore / 100;
&nbsp;
    // Garantir que não há divisão por zero ou variância negativa com N insuficiente
    if (effectiveN &lt;= 2.1) return 1.5 * scaleFactorFallback; // Retorna incerteza base
&nbsp;
    // Normaliza pela soma dos pesos e aplica o fator de correção para amostras pequenas
    const variance = (rss / sumW) * (effectiveN / Math.max(0.1, effectiveN - 2));
    const det = sumW * sumWXX - sumWX * sumWX;
&nbsp;
    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (Math.abs(det) &lt; 1e-6) <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >return 1.5;</span>
    return Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, (variance * sumW) / det));
}

// -----------------------------
// Volatilidade Robusta (MSSD + MAD Blended)
// -----------------------------
export function calculateRobustVolatility(history, maxScore = 100, minScore = 0, options = {}) {
    const sorted = getSortedHistory(history);
    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (!sorted || sorted.length &lt; 2) {
        const range = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >maxScore - minScore &gt; 0 ? maxScore - minScore : maxScore;</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        return 0.05 * range;</span>
    }
&nbsp;
    const lambda = options.lambda || 0.08;
    const now = options.referenceDate || Date.now();
    const scaleFactorFallback = (maxScore - minScore &gt; 0 ? maxScore - minScore : <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >maxScore)</span> / 100;
&nbsp;
    const { slope, intercept } = weightedRegression(sorted, lambda, maxScore, options);
    const t0_vol = new Date(sorted[0].date || <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >sorted[0].createdAt)</span>.getTime();
&nbsp;
    const residualSamples = sorted.map(h =&gt; {
        const hDate = h.date || <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >h.createdAt;</span>
        const x = (new Date(hDate).getTime() - t0_vol) / 86400000;
        const t = (now - new Date(hDate).getTime()) / 86400000;
        const w = Math.exp(-lambda * t);
        const y = getSafeScore(h, maxScore);
        const pred = intercept + slope * x;
        return { value: y - pred, weight: w }; // Resíduos reais (detrended)
    });
&nbsp;
    // Variância Ponderada dos Resíduos (Robust Component)
    const sumWeights = residualSamples.reduce((acc, it) =&gt; acc + it.weight, 0);
    const sumResidualsWeighted = residualSamples.reduce((acc, it) =&gt; acc + it.value * it.weight, 0);
    const sumSw = residualSamples.reduce((acc, it) =&gt; acc + it.value * it.value * it.weight, 0);
&nbsp;
    const expectedResidual = sumResidualsWeighted / sumWeights;
    const n_res = sorted.length - 1;
    const bessel = n_res &gt; 1 ? n_res / (n_res - 1) : <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >1;</span>
    const mssdVariance = ((sumSw / sumWeights) - (expectedResidual * expectedResidual)) * bessel;
&nbsp;
    const weightedMedian = (arr) =&gt; {
        <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (!arr.length) <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >return 0;</span>
        const sortedArr = [...arr].sort((a, b) =&gt; a.value - b.value);
        const totalW = sortedArr.reduce((acc, it) =&gt; acc + it.weight, 0);
        let accW = 0;
        for (const it of sortedArr) {
            accW += it.weight;
            if (accW &gt;= totalW * 0.5) return it.value;
        }
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        return sortedArr[sortedArr.length - 1].value;</span>
    };
&nbsp;
    const medianResidual = weightedMedian(residualSamples);
    const absDev = residualSamples.map(it =&gt; ({ value: Math.abs(it.value - medianResidual), weight: it.weight }));
    const mad = weightedMedian(absDev);
    const robustSigma = 1.4826 * mad;
    const robustVariance = robustSigma * robustSigma;
    const blendedVariance = (0.75 * mssdVariance) + (0.25 * robustVariance);
&nbsp;
    return Math.sqrt(Math.max(Math.pow(1.0 * scaleFactorFallback, 2), blendedVariance));
}
&nbsp;
export function calculateVolatility(history, maxScore = 100, minScore = 0) {
    if (!Array.isArray(history) || history.length &lt; 2) {
        const range = maxScore - minScore &gt; 0 ? maxScore - minScore : <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >maxScore;</span>
        return 0.05 * range;
    }
    const scores = history.map(h =&gt; getSafeScore(h, maxScore));
    const meanVal = scores.reduce((a, b) =&gt; a + b, 0) / scores.length;
    const variance = scores.reduce((a, b) =&gt; a + Math.pow(b - meanVal, 2), 0) / (scores.length - 1);
    return Math.sqrt(variance);
}

// -----------------------------
// MSSD — Mean Successive Squared Differences (BUG-MATH-01)
// Mede instabilidade SEM penalizar crescimento monotônico.
// Ex: [50,60,70] → SD=10 (penaliza), MSSD_root=10 (mesmo)
// Ex: [50,70,50,70] → SD=11.5, MSSD_root=20 (detecta oscilação)
// Ex: [50,55,60,65] → SD=6.5 (penaliza crescimento), MSSD_root=5 (correto: baixa instabilidade)
// -----------------------------
export function calculateMSSD(history, maxScore = 100, minScore = 0) {
    if (!Array.isArray(history) || history.length &lt; 2) {
        const range = maxScore - minScore &gt; 0 ? maxScore - minScore : <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >maxScore;</span>
        return 0.05 * range;
    }
    const scores = history.map(h =&gt; getSafeScore(h, maxScore));
    const n = scores.length;
    
    // Detrending Linear Rápido
    let sumX = 0, sumY = 0, sumXY = 0, sumXX = 0;
    for(let i = 0; i &lt; n; i++) {
        sumX += i; sumY += scores[i]; sumXY += i * scores[i]; sumXX += i * i;
    }
    const det = n * sumXX - sumX * sumX;
    const slope = det === 0 ? <span class="branch-0 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >0 </span>: (n * sumXY - sumX * sumY) / det;
    
    const detrendedScores = scores.map((y, i) =&gt; y - (slope * i));
    
    let sumSqDiff = 0;
    for (let i = 1; i &lt; n; i++) {
        sumSqDiff += Math.pow(detrendedScores[i] - detrendedScores[i - 1], 2);
    }
    
    const rmssd = (sumSqDiff / 2) / Math.max(1, n - 1); 
    return Math.sqrt(Math.max(1e-6, rmssd));
}

// -----------------------------
// EMA Dinâmico
// -----------------------------
export function calculateDynamicEMA(currentScore, previousEMA, n, daysSinceLast = 1) {
    const baseAlpha = 2 / (n + 1);
    // Ajusta alpha pelo tempo: quanto mais tempo passou, mais peso damos ao score atual (decay da memória)
    const timeWeight = 1 - Math.exp(-daysSinceLast / 7); // 7 dias como constante de tempo
    const alpha = Math.min(0.8, baseAlpha + (1 - baseAlpha) * timeWeight);
    return alpha * currentScore + (1 - alpha) * previousEMA;
}

// -----------------------------
// Drift Clampeado (Prevenção de outliers)
// IMP-MATH-06: λ adaptativo baseado no gap mediano entre sessões
// -----------------------------
export function calculateSlope(history, maxScore = 100, options = {}) {
    // Calcular λ adaptativo: alunos com sessões frequentes usam λ maior (memória curta)
    const sorted = getSortedHistory(history);
    let lambda = 0.08; // default
    if (sorted.length &gt;= 3) {
        const gaps = [];
        for (let i = 1; i &lt; sorted.length; i++) {
            const gap = Math.max(0.5, (new Date(sorted[i].date || <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >sorted[i].createdAt)</span> - new Date(sorted[i - 1].date || <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >sorted[i - 1].createdAt)</span>) / 86400000);
            gaps.push(gap);
        }
        gaps.sort((a, b) =&gt; a - b);
        const medianGap = gaps.length % 2 === 0
            ? (gaps[gaps.length / 2 - 1] + gaps[gaps.length / 2]) / 2
            : gaps[Math.floor(gaps.length / 2)];
        // λ ∈ [0.03, 0.12]: sessões frequentes → λ alto (esquece rápido), sessões espaçadas → λ baixo
        lambda = Math.max(0.03, Math.min(0.12, 0.03 + 0.08 * Math.exp(-medianGap / 10)));
    }
    const { slope } = weightedRegression(history, lambda, maxScore, options);
    // CORREÇÃO: Limita o drift diário a 1.5% da escala total para permitir
    // a captação da curva íngreme de aprendizagem de alunos iniciantes (até 45% ao mês).
    const limit = 0.015 * maxScore;
    return Math.max(-limit, Math.min(limit, slope));
}

}

/**
 * Calcula o Damping Base adaptativo baseado no histórico.

export function computeAdaptiveDampingBase({ sampleSize, drift, driftUncertainty, scaleFactor, normalizedVol }) {
    const n = Math.max(1, Number(sampleSize) || 1);
    const safeDrift = Number.isFinite(drift) ? drift : <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >0;</span>
    const safeUncertainty = Math.max(1e-6, Number(driftUncertainty) || <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >0)</span>;
    const safeScale = Math.max(1e-6, Number(scaleFactor) || <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >1)</span>;
    const safeNormVol = Math.max(0, Number(normalizedVol) || <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >0)</span>;
&nbsp;
    const nConfidence = 1 - Math.exp(-n / 12);
    const trendSNR = Math.abs(safeDrift) / Math.max(0.05 * safeScale, safeUncertainty);
    const trendConfidence = Math.tanh(trendSNR / 2);
    const volPenalty = Math.min(1, safeNormVol / 18);
    const confidenceScore = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (0.5 * nConfidence) + (0.35 * trendConfidence) + (0.15 * (1 - volPenalty))));
    return 30 + (30 * confidenceScore);
}

<span class="cline-any cline-neutral">&nbsp;</span></td><td class="text"><pre class="prettyprint lang-js">export function mulberry32(seed) {
    return function () {
        let t = seed += 0x6D2B79F5;
        t = Math.imul(t ^ (t &gt;&gt;&gt; 15), t | 1);
        t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t &gt;&gt;&gt; 7), t | 61);
        return ((t ^ (t &gt;&gt;&gt; 14)) &gt;&gt;&gt; 0) / 4294967296;
    };
}
&nbsp;
// BUGFIX H3: Box-Muller completo com cache do 2° valor.
// Antes: sin() era calculado e descartado, dobrando as chamadas ao RNG.
// Agora: o 2° valor é guardado em closure e retornado na próxima chamada.
// ⚠️ ATENÇÃO: altera a sequência do RNG — seeds existentes produzirão valores diferentes.
// Se reprodutibilidade de seeds históricas for crítica, manter o código antigo e comentar esta mudança.
export function makeNormalRng(rng) {
    let spare;
    let hasSpare = false;
    return () =&gt; {
        if (hasSpare) {
            hasSpare = false;
            return spare;
        }
        let u = 0, v = 0;
        while (u === 0) u = rng();
        while (v === 0) v = rng();
        const mag = Math.sqrt(-2.0 * Math.log(u));
        spare = mag * Math.sin(2.0 * Math.PI * v);
        hasSpare = true;
        return mag * Math.cos(2.0 * Math.PI * v);
    };
}
&nbsp;
export function <span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >randomNormal(</span>rng) {
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (rng._normalFn === undefined) {</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        rng._normalFn = makeNormalRng(rng);</span>
    }
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return rng._normalFn();</span>
}

export const BAYESIAN_DECAY_FACTOR = 0.985;
import { getSafeScore, getSyntheticTotal } from '../utils/scoreHelper.js';
// BUG-08 FIX: Importar calculateSlope para consistência com Monte Carlo
import { calculateSlope } from './projection.js';
import { Z_95, MIN_SD_FLOOR } from './math/constants.js';

&nbsp;
function <span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >getDynamicTrendThreshold(</span>currentScore, maxScore) {
    const currentPct = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >currentScore / maxScore;</span>
    
    // Fator de amortecimento: se o aluno tirou 40%, damping = 0.6. Se tirou 95%, damping = 0.05.
    const damping = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >Math.max(0, 1 - currentPct);</span>
    
    // Curva de exigência: Inicia agressiva (ex: 4~5% para novatos) e cai para um mínimo de 0.2% para veteranos.
    const baseRequirement = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >0.05; </span>
    const dynamicPct = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >(baseRequirement * Math.pow(damping, 1.5)) + 0.002; </span>
    
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return dynamicPct * maxScore;</span>
}
&nbsp;
// O desvio padrão a priori passa a ser a própria volatilidade do usuário, 
// com um piso de 5% e teto de 20% para evitar colapso bayesiano.
function getDynamicPriorSD(history, maxScore) {
    if (!history || history.length &lt; 5) return maxScore * 0.15; // Fallback inicial seguro
    const scores = history.map(h =&gt; getSafeScore(h, maxScore));
    const globalMean = mean(scores);
    const globalVar = scores.length &gt; 1
        ? scores.reduce((acc, s) =&gt; acc + Math.pow(s - globalMean, 2), 0) / (scores.length - 1)
        : <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >0;</span>
    
    const empiricalSD = Math.sqrt(globalVar);
    return Math.max(maxScore * 0.05, Math.min(maxScore * 0.20, empiricalSD));
}

export function mean(arr) {
    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (!arr || !arr.length) <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >return 0;</span>

    return clean.reduce((a, b) =&gt; a + b, 0) / clean.length;
}
export const calcularMedia = mean;

export function standardDeviation(arr, maxScore = 100, customMean = null) {
    if (!arr || arr.length &lt; 1) return 0;
    const clean = arr.map(Number).filter(Number.isFinite);
    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (clean.length &lt; 1) <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >return 0;</span>
&nbsp;
    const safeMaxScore = Number.isFinite(Number(maxScore)) &amp;&amp; Number(maxScore) &gt; 0 ? Number(maxScore) : <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >100;</span>
    const n = clean.length;
    const m = customMean !== null &amp;&amp; <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >Number.isFinite(Number(customMean)) </span>? <span class="branch-0 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >Number(customMean) </span>: mean(clean);
&nbsp;
&nbsp;
    // Cálculo de Desvio Padrão Robusto (sample + MAD)
    const sampleVar = n &gt; 1
        ? clean.reduce((sum, val) =&gt; sum + Math.pow(val - m, 2), 0) / (n - 1)
        : 0;
&nbsp;
    const sorted = [...clean].sort((a, b) =&gt; a - b);
    const median = sorted.length % 2 === 0
        ? <span class="branch-0 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >(sorted[sorted.length / 2 - 1] + sorted[sorted.length / 2]) / 2</span>
        : sorted[Math.floor(sorted.length / 2)];
    const absDev = sorted.map(v =&gt; Math.abs(v - median)).sort((a, b) =&gt; a - b);
    const mad = absDev.length % 2 === 0
        ? <span class="branch-0 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >(absDev[absDev.length / 2 - 1] + absDev[absDev.length / 2]) / 2</span>
        : absDev[Math.floor(absDev.length / 2)];
&nbsp;
    const robustSigma = 1.4826 * mad;
    const robustVar = robustSigma * robustSigma;
    const blendedSampleVar = (0.8 * sampleVar) + (0.2 * robustVar);
&nbsp;
    // MATH FIX: O prior de incerteza (POPULATION_SD) deve ser ancorado na escala do concurso (maxScore)
    const POPULATION_SD = getDynamicPriorSD(arr, safeMaxScore);
    const KAPPA = 1;
&nbsp;
    const adjustedVar = ((n - 1) * blendedSampleVar + KAPPA * Math.pow(POPULATION_SD, 2)) / ((n - 1) + KAPPA);
&nbsp;
    const finalSdFloor = MIN_SD_FLOOR * safeMaxScore;
    return Math.max(finalSdFloor, Math.sqrt(adjustedVar));
&nbsp;
}

<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (!arr || arr.length === 0) <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >return 0;</span></span>

/**
 * Nível Bayesiano Real — Modelo Beta-Binomial Conjugado
 * Prior: Beta(1,1) = Uniforme (Laplace Smoothing).
 * Assumimos total desconhecimento do Nível inicial do aluno (mais justo).
 * A cada simulado: alpha += acertos, beta += erros.
 * Retorna média posterior + IC 95%.
 */
export function computeBayesianLevel(history, alpha0 = 1, beta0 = 1, maxScore = 100, options = {}) {
    const safeMaxScore = Number.isFinite(Number(maxScore)) &amp;&amp; Number(maxScore) &gt; 0 ? Number(maxScore) : <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >100;</span>
    let alpha = alpha0;
    let beta = beta0;
    let maxNEver = alpha0 + beta0;
    
    // 🎯 O Teto é vivo. Baseia-se na constância do aluno.
    // No início da função computeBayesianLevel, substitua o bloco do dynamicAlphaCap:
    const sessionGaps = history &amp;&amp; history.length &gt; 1 
        ? history.map((h, i) =&gt; i &gt; 0 ? (new Date(h.date) - new Date(history[i-1].date)) / 86400000 : 0) 
        : [0];
    const avgGap = Math.max(0.1, sessionGaps.reduce((a, b) =&gt; a + b, 0) / Math.max(1, sessionGaps.length - 1));
&nbsp;
    // CORREÇÃO: Estimar capacidade viva baseada no volume diário real
    const totalQuestionsHist = history ? history.reduce((acc, h) =&gt; acc + (Number(h.total) || <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >20)</span>, 0) : <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >0;</span>
    const historyDays = history &amp;&amp; history.length &gt; 1 
        ? Math.max(1, (new Date(history[history.length-1].date) - new Date(history[0].date)) / 86400000) 
        : 1;
    const questionsPerDay = totalQuestionsHist / historyDays;
&nbsp;
    // Capacidade base (Tempo) vs Capacidade de Volume (30 dias de memória ativa)
    const baseCapacity = 250 / avgGap;
    const volumeCapacity = questionsPerDay * 30;
    
    // O teto adapta-se à realidade hiperativa do aluno
    const dynamicAlphaCap = Math.max(250, Math.floor(Math.min(baseCapacity, volumeCapacity)));
    const dynamicEffectiveN = dynamicAlphaCap;
    
    const now = Date.now();
&nbsp;
    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="else path not taken" >E</span>if (history &amp;&amp; history.length &gt; 0) {
        const sortedHistory = [...history].sort((a, b) =&gt; new Date(a.date) - new Date(b.date));
        
        for (let i = 0; i &lt; sortedHistory.length; i++) {
            const h = sortedHistory[i];
            let total = Number(h.total) || <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >0;</span>
            const isPurePercentage = (total === 0 &amp;&amp; <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >h.score != null)</span>;
&nbsp;
            const normalizedScore = getSafeScore(h, safeMaxScore);
            let rawPct = normalizedScore / safeMaxScore;
&nbsp;
            if (options.isPenalizedFormat) {
                rawPct = Math.max(0.05, (rawPct + 1) / 2);
            } else {
                rawPct = Math.max(0, rawPct);
            }
            const pct = Math.min(1, rawPct);
&nbsp;
            // 1. O cálculo de tempo (gap) e esquecimento tem de ocorrer ANTES de injetar o novo simulado
            const entryDate = new Date(h.date);
            const prevDate = i &gt; 0 ? new Date(sortedHistory[i - 1].date) : entryDate;
            const gapDays = Math.max(0, Math.floor((entryDate - prevDate) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)));
&nbsp;
            const adaptiveLambdaBase = computeAdaptiveLambda(sortedHistory);
            const rawLambda = adaptiveLambdaBase * Math.exp(-0.15 * i);
            const lambda = Math.max(0.005, rawLambda); 
            const entryDecay = i &gt; 0 ? Math.exp(-lambda * gapDays) : 1.0;
&nbsp;
            const cappedMaxN = Math.min(maxNEver, dynamicAlphaCap);
            const macroDecay = Math.max(0.1, Math.exp(-0.005 * (gapDays || 0))); 
            const retentionFloor = (cappedMaxN * 0.3) * macroDecay;
&nbsp;
            if (entryDecay &lt; 1.0) {
                const nBeforeDecay = alpha + beta;
                const currentP = nBeforeDecay &gt; 0 ? alpha / nBeforeDecay : <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >0.5;</span>
                const minN = retentionFloor;
                const HARD_FLOOR = 3.0;
                
                const nAfterDecay = nBeforeDecay &lt; minN 
                    ? <span class="branch-0 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >Math.max(HARD_FLOOR, nBeforeDecay * entryDecay)</span>
                    : Math.max(Math.max(minN, HARD_FLOOR), nBeforeDecay * entryDecay);
                
                alpha = nAfterDecay * currentP;
                beta = nAfterDecay * (1 - currentP);
            }
&nbsp;
            // 2. Agora injetamos a nota na matemática (SEM usar `continue`)
            <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (isPurePercentage) {
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >                alpha += pct * 0.5;</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >                beta += (1 - pct) * 0.5;</span>
            } else {
                let correct = Math.round(pct * total);
                <span class="missing-if-branch" title="else path not taken" >E</span>if (total &gt;= 1) {
                    // Sanitização de acertos
                    const safeCorrect = Math.max(0, Math.min(total, correct));
                    const acertosHoje = safeCorrect;
                    const errosHoje = total - safeCorrect;
                    alpha += acertosHoje;
                    beta += errosHoje;
                }
            }
&nbsp;
            // 3. Atualizamos o teto global com os novos valores
            const currentN = alpha + beta;
            <span class="missing-if-branch" title="else path not taken" >E</span>if (currentN &gt; maxNEver) maxNEver = Math.min(currentN, dynamicAlphaCap);
        }
        
        // Decaimento final até o dia de hoje
        const lastDate = new Date(sortedHistory[sortedHistory.length - 1].date);
        const gapToToday = Math.max(0, Math.floor((now - lastDate.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)));
        <span class="missing-if-branch" title="else path not taken" >E</span>if (gapToToday &gt; 0) {
            const cappedMaxN = Math.min(maxNEver, dynamicAlphaCap);
            // [DEPOIS] Piso dinâmico que esvazia com o tempo
            const macroDecay = Math.max(0.1, Math.exp(-0.005 * (gapToToday || <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >0)</span>)); 
            const retentionFloor = (cappedMaxN * 0.3) * macroDecay;
            
            const finalLambdaBase = computeAdaptiveLambda(sortedHistory);
            
            // CORREÇÃO MATH: O mesmo piso é aplicado aqui para consistência assintótica.
            const rawFinalLambda = finalLambdaBase * Math.exp(-0.15 * sortedHistory.length);
            const finalLambda = Math.max(0.005, rawFinalLambda);
            
            const finalDecay = Math.exp(-finalLambda * gapToToday);
            const nBeforeDecay = alpha + beta;
            const currentP = nBeforeDecay &gt; 0 ? alpha / nBeforeDecay : <span class="branch-1 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >0.5;</span>
            
            const minN = retentionFloor;
            // [CORREÇÃO MATH-BUG-1] Aplica a mesma lógica de não-inflação artificial
            const HARD_FLOOR = 3.0;
            const nAfterDecay = nBeforeDecay &lt; minN 
                ? <span class="branch-0 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >Math.max(HARD_FLOOR, nBeforeDecay * finalDecay)</span>
                : Math.max(Math.max(minN, HARD_FLOOR), nBeforeDecay * finalDecay);
            
            // CORREÇÃO: Apenas decair o N, mantendo o P atual
            alpha = nAfterDecay * currentP;
            beta = nAfterDecay * (1 - currentP);
        }
    }
&nbsp;
    const n = alpha + beta;
    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n &lt;= 0) {
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        return { mean: 0, sd: 0, ciLow: 0, ciHigh: 0, alpha: alpha0, beta: beta0, n: 0 };</span>
    }
    
    const effectiveN = Math.min(n, dynamicEffectiveN);
&nbsp;
    const p = alpha / n;
    const bayesianMean = p * safeMaxScore;
    const effectiveAlpha = p * effectiveN;
&nbsp;
    const z2 = Z_95 * Z_95;
    const n_tilde = effectiveN + z2;
    const p_tilde = (effectiveAlpha + z2 / 2) / n_tilde;
&nbsp;
    // CORREÇÃO: Em vez de Math.max(20, ...), permitimos que o tamanho físico 
    // real da prova não seja artificialmente distorcido se for uma prova pequena.

<span class="cline-any cline-neutral">&nbsp;</span></td><td class="text"><pre class="prettyprint lang-js">/**
 * Monte Carlo Engine - Variance Module
 * 
 * Implements weighted variance calculation and time uncertainty
 * All formulas are statistically correct and auditable
 */
&nbsp;
/**
 * Compute weighted variance from category statistics
 * Formula: Var = (1 - ρ) × [Σ wi² × σi²] + ρ × [Σ (wi × σi)]²
 * Calcula a variância ponderada interpolando entre a hipótese de independência 
 * das disciplinas (ρ = 0) e a hipótese de correlação perfeita (ρ = 1).
 * 
 * BUG-M3: This formula is statistically correct under the assumption of
 * independence between subjects. If subjects are strongly correlated
 * (shared test-day effects), the true variance lies between this value
 * and the correlated formula (Σ w_i*σ_i)².
 * 
 * CONTRACT: totalWeight must be the sum of all raw weights. If stats weights are 
 * already normalized (0-1), totalWeight MUST be passed as 1 for correct computations.
 * 
 * @param {Object[]} stats - Array of { sd, weight } objects
 * @param {number} totalWeight - Sum of all weights (use 1 if stats weights are normalized)
 * @returns {number} Weighted variance
 */
// CORREÇÃO: Alinhamento com Modelos TRI (Teoria de Resposta ao Item).
// 0.25 capta melhor a covariância psicológica (stress do dia) 
// sem esmagar o Desvio Padrão Agregado (Pooled SD) do candidato.
export const INTER_SUBJECT_CORRELATION = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >0.25;</span>
&nbsp;
export function <span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >computeEffectiveSampleSizeFromWeights(</span>weights = <span class="branch-0 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >[])</span> {
    const clean = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >Array.isArray(weights) ? weights.map(<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >w </span>=&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >Number(w))</span>.filter(<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >w </span>=&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >Number.isFinite(w) &amp;&amp; w &gt; 0)</span> : [];</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (clean.length === 0) <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >return 0;</span></span>
    const sumW = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >clean.reduce(<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >(a</span>, b) =&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >a + b,</span> 0);</span>
    const sumW2 = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >clean.reduce(<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >(a</span>, b) =&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >a + (b * b),</span> 0);</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return sumW2 &gt; 0 ? (sumW * sumW) / sumW2 : 0;</span>
}
&nbsp;
// FIX 2.3: Proteção estrita contra a injeção de parâmetros corrompidos (null/NaN) do DB
export function <span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >computeWeightedVariance(</span>stats, totalWeight, rho = <span class="branch-0 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >INTER_SUBJECT_CORRELATION,</span> preserveScale = <span class="branch-0 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >false)</span> {
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (!Array.isArray(stats) || stats.length === 0) <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >return 0;</span></span>
&nbsp;
    // BUG 7 FIX: Use the provided totalWeight if valid, otherwise fallback to calculated total.
    // This respects the function contract while remaining defensive.
    const toFiniteNonNegative = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" ><span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >(v</span>alue) =&gt; {</span>
        const n = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >Number(value);</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        return Number.isFinite(n) &amp;&amp; n &gt; 0 ? n : 0;</span>
    };
&nbsp;
    const toFiniteSd = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" ><span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >(v</span>alue) =&gt; {</span>
        const n = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >Number(value);</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        return Number.isFinite(n) &amp;&amp; n &gt;= 0 ? n : 0;</span>
    };
&nbsp;
    const calculatedTotalWeight = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >stats.reduce(<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >(a</span>cc, cat) =&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >acc + toFiniteNonNegative(cat?.weight),</span> 0);</span>
    const effectiveTotalWeight = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >(Number.isFinite(totalWeight) &amp;&amp; totalWeight &gt; 0) ? totalWeight : calculatedTotalWeight;</span>
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (effectiveTotalWeight === 0) <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >return 0;</span></span>
&nbsp;
    // Garantia absoluta de tipo e limite para correlação
    const validRho = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >Number.isFinite(rho) &amp;&amp; rho !== null ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, rho)) : INTER_SUBJECT_CORRELATION;</span>
&nbsp;
    const rawWeights = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >stats.map(<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >cat </span>=&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >toFiniteNonNegative(cat?.weight))</span>;</span>
    const adjustedSDs = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >stats.map(<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >cat </span>=&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >toFiniteSd(cat?.sd))</span>;</span>
&nbsp;
    // SAFETY: If caller passes inconsistent totalWeight, force normalized simplex weights (Σwi=1).
    // This preserves scale invariance of linear-combination variance instead of silently shrinking/blowing up SD.
    const sumRawWeights = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >rawWeights.reduce(<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >(a</span>cc, w) =&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >acc + w,</span> 0);</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (!Number.isFinite(sumRawWeights) || sumRawWeights &lt;= 0) <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >return 0;</span></span>
    
    // FIX BUG-VAR-01: Adicionar opção para preservar a escala real (edital)
    const weights = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >preserveScale </span>
        ? rawWeights 
        : rawWeights.map(<span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >w </span>=&gt; <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >w / sumRawWeights)</span>; // Fallback para simplex
&nbsp;
    // 1. Independent Variance Component (Weighted Sum of Variances): Σ (wi² * σi²)

/* eslint-disable */
var addSorting = (function() {
    'use strict';
    var cols,
        currentSort = {
            index: 0,
            desc: false
        };

    // returns the summary table element
    function getTable() {
        return document.querySelector('.coverage-summary');
    }
    // returns the thead element of the summary table
    function getTableHeader() {
        return getTable().querySelector('thead tr');
    }
    // returns the tbody element of the summary table
    function getTableBody() {
        return getTable().querySelector('tbody');
    }
    // returns the th element for nth column
    function getNthColumn(n) {
        return getTableHeader().querySelectorAll('th')[n];
    }

    function onFilterInput() {
        const searchValue = document.getElementById('fileSearch').value;
        const rows = document.getElementsByTagName('tbody')[0].children;

        // Try to create a RegExp from the searchValue. If it fails (invalid regex),
        // it will be treated as a plain text search
        let searchRegex;
        try {
            searchRegex = new RegExp(searchValue, 'i'); // 'i' for case-insensitive
        } catch (error) {
            searchRegex = null;
        }

        for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
            const row = rows[i];
            let isMatch = false;

            if (searchRegex) {
                // If a valid regex was created, use it for matching
                isMatch = searchRegex.test(row.textContent);
            } else {
                // Otherwise, fall back to the original plain text search
                isMatch = row.textContent
                    .toLowerCase()
                    .includes(searchValue.toLowerCase());
            }

            row.style.display = isMatch ? '' : 'none';
        }
    }

    // loads the search box
    function addSearchBox() {
        var template = document.getElementById('filterTemplate');
        var templateClone = template.content.cloneNode(true);
        templateClone.getElementById('fileSearch').oninput = onFilterInput;
        template.parentElement.appendChild(templateClone);
    }

    // loads all columns
    function loadColumns() {
        var colNodes = getTableHeader().querySelectorAll('th'),
            colNode,
            cols = [],
            col,
            i;

        for (i = 0; i < colNodes.length; i += 1) {
            colNode = colNodes[i];
            col = {
                key: colNode.getAttribute('data-col'),
                sortable: !colNode.getAttribute('data-nosort'),
                type: colNode.getAttribute('data-type') || 'string'
            };
            cols.push(col);
            if (col.sortable) {
                col.defaultDescSort = col.type === 'number';
                colNode.innerHTML =
                    colNode.innerHTML + '<span class="sorter"></span>';
            }
        }
        return cols;
    }
    // attaches a data attribute to every tr element with an object
    // of data values keyed by column name
    function loadRowData(tableRow) {
        var tableCols = tableRow.querySelectorAll('td'),
            colNode,
            col,
            data = {},
            i,
            val;
        for (i = 0; i < tableCols.length; i += 1) {
            colNode = tableCols[i];
            col = cols[i];
            val = colNode.getAttribute('data-value');
            if (col.type === 'number') {
                val = Number(val);
            }
            data[col.key] = val;
        }
        return data;
    }
    // loads all row data
    function loadData() {
        var rows = getTableBody().querySelectorAll('tr'),
            i;

        for (i = 0; i < rows.length; i += 1) {
            rows[i].data = loadRowData(rows[i]);
        }
    }
    // sorts the table using the data for the ith column
    function sortByIndex(index, desc) {
        var key = cols[index].key,
            sorter = function(a, b) {
                a = a.data[key];
                b = b.data[key];
                return a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0;
            },
            finalSorter = sorter,
            tableBody = document.querySelector('.coverage-summary tbody'),
            rowNodes = tableBody.querySelectorAll('tr'),
            rows = [],
            i;

        if (desc) {
            finalSorter = function(a, b) {
                return -1 * sorter(a, b);
            };
        }

        for (i = 0; i < rowNodes.length; i += 1) {
            rows.push(rowNodes[i]);
            tableBody.removeChild(rowNodes[i]);
        }

        rows.sort(finalSorter);

        for (i = 0; i < rows.length; i += 1) {
            tableBody.appendChild(rows[i]);
        }
    }
    // removes sort indicators for current column being sorted
    function removeSortIndicators() {
        var col = getNthColumn(currentSort.index),
            cls = col.className;

        cls = cls.replace(/ sorted$/, '').replace(/ sorted-desc$/, '');
        col.className = cls;
    }
    // adds sort indicators for current column being sorted
    function addSortIndicators() {
        getNthColumn(currentSort.index).className += currentSort.desc
            ? ' sorted-desc'
            : ' sorted';
    }
    // adds event listeners for all sorter widgets
    function enableUI() {
        var i,
            el,
            ithSorter = function ithSorter(i) {
                var col = cols[i];

                return function() {
                    var desc = col.defaultDescSort;

                    if (currentSort.index === i) {
                        desc = !currentSort.desc;
                    }
                    sortByIndex(i, desc);
                    removeSortIndicators();
                    currentSort.index = i;
                    currentSort.desc = desc;
                    addSortIndicators();
                };
            };
        for (i = 0; i < cols.length; i += 1) {
            if (cols[i].sortable) {
                // add the click event handler on the th so users
                // dont have to click on those tiny arrows
                el = getNthColumn(i).querySelector('.sorter').parentElement;
                if (el.addEventListener) {
                    el.addEventListener('click', ithSorter(i));
                } else {
                    el.attachEvent('onclick', ithSorter(i));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    // adds sorting functionality to the UI
    return function() {
        if (!getTable()) {
            return;
        }
        cols = loadColumns();
        loadData();
        addSearchBox();
        addSortIndicators();
        enableUI();
    };
})();

window.addEventListener('load', addSorting);

<span class="cline-any cline-neutral">&nbsp;</span></td><td class="text"><pre class="prettyprint lang-js">// ==================== CONSTANTES ====================
import { standardDeviation } from '../engine/stats.js';
import { calculateMSSD, calculateSlope } from '../engine/projection.js';
import { computeForgettingRisk } from '../engine/diagnostics.js';
import { getSafeScore, getSyntheticTotal, formatValue, formatPercent } from './scoreHelper.js';
import { normalize } from './normalization.js';
import { computeRollingCalibrationParams } from './calibration.js';
import { 
    deriveAdaptiveRiskThresholds, 
    computeContinuousMcBoost, 
    deriveBacktestWeights,
    deriveCoachAdaptiveParams,
    runCoachMonteCarlo,
    clearMcCache,
    simuladosToHistory
} from './coachAdaptive.js';
import { computeAdaptiveCoachWeight } from './adaptiveMath.js';
export { deriveAdaptiveRiskThresholds, computeContinuousMcBoost, deriveBacktestWeights, clearMcCache, runCoachMonteCarlo };
&nbsp;
&nbsp;
export const DEFAULT_CONFIG = {
    SCORE_MAX: 50,
    RECENCY_MAX: 30,
    INSTABILITY_MAX: 30,
    PRIORITY_BOOST: 30,
    EFFICIENCY_MAX: 15,
    SRS_BOOST: 20,
    BASE_HOURS_THRESHOLD: 5,
&nbsp;
    // Monte Carlo
    MC_SIMULATIONS: 800,          // ← BUG-C2 FIX: era 5000 (conflitava com o comentário "MC leve")
    MC_MIN_DATA_POINTS: 3,
    MC_PROB_DANGER: 30,
    MC_PROB_SAFE: 90,
    MC_VOLATILITY_HIGH: 8,
    INSTABILITY_MSSD_DIVISOR: 10,
    MC_BACKTEST_HORIZON: 3,
    MC_BACKTEST_HORIZON_MAX: 6,
    MC_CALIBRATION_BRIER_BASELINE: 0.18,
    MC_CALIBRATION_MAX_PENALTY: 0.25,
    MC_CALIBRATION_NEUTRAL_PCT: 50,
    MC_CALIBRATION_MAX_APPLIED_PENALTY: 0.5,
    MC_ENABLE_ADAPTIVE_CALIBRATION: true,
    MC_CALIB_WINDOW_DAYS: 60,
    MC_CALIB_MIN_SAMPLES: 4,
    MC_CALIB_MAX_SAMPLES: 20,
    MC_ECE_BINS_MIN: 4,
    MC_ECE_BINS_MID: 6,
    MC_ECE_BINS_MAX: 8,
    MC_LOW_SAMPLE_THRESHOLD: 10,
&nbsp;
    // ── A) Constantes do urgency boost nomeadas ──────────────────────────────
    // Antes: mcUrgencyBoost = 12 + 13 * (1 - p/MC_PROB_DANGER)
    //        → 12 = boost base na fronteira de perigo
    //        → 25 = boost máximo quando probabilidade é 0% (12+13)
    //        → -8 = recompensa passiva quando em modo cruzeiro (prob &gt;= 90%)
    MC_BOOST_DANGER_BASE: 12,     // boost quando prob está exactly no limiar (30%)
    MC_BOOST_DANGER_RANGE: 13,    // faixa adicional conforme prob se aproxima de 0%
    MC_BOOST_MODERATE_BASE: 12,   // boost na transição danger→moderate
    MC_BOOST_SAFE_PENALTY: -8,    // redução de urgência quando prob &gt;= 90% (modo cruzeiro)
    MC_MODERATE_MIDPOINT: 55,     // prob (%) que separa zona moderate-alta de moderate-baixa
};
&nbsp;
function getDynamicTrendThreshold(currentScore, maxScore) {
    const currentPct = currentScore / maxScore;
    
    // Fator de amortecimento: se o aluno tirou 40%, damping = 0.6. Se tirou 95%, damping = 0.05.
    const damping = Math.max(0, 1 - currentPct);
    
    // Curva de exigência: Inicia agressiva (ex: 4~5% para novatos) e cai para um mínimo de 0.2% para veteranos.
    const baseRequirement = 0.05; 
    const dynamicPct = (baseRequirement * Math.pow(damping, 1.5)) + 0.002; 
    
    return dynamicPct * maxScore;
}
&nbsp;
// ==================== FUNÇÕES AUXILIARES ====================
&nbsp;
const normalizeDate = (dateInput) =&gt; {
    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (!dateInput) <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >return new Date(0);</span>
    try {
        const d = typeof dateInput === 'string' &amp;&amp; dateInput.length === 10
            ? new Date(`${dateInput}T12:00:00`)
            : new Date(dateInput);
        if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return new Date(0);
        d.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
        return d;
    } catch {
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        return new Date(0);</span>
    }
};
&nbsp;
const MS_PER_DAY = 1000 * 60 * 60 * 24;
&nbsp;
const getDaysDiff = (newer, older) =&gt; {
    const newerDate = normalizeDate(newer);
    const olderDate = normalizeDate(older);
    return Math.max(0, Math.floor((newerDate.getTime() - olderDate.getTime()) / MS_PER_DAY));
};
&nbsp;
function getCrunchMultiplier(daysToExam, historyStartDate) {
    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="else path not taken" >E</span>if (daysToExam === undefined || daysToExam === null || <span class="branch-2 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >daysToExam &lt; 0)</span> return 1.0;
    
    // 1. Descobre a extensão total do projeto do aluno
    let totalJourneyDays = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >90;</span> // Default razoável
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (historyStartDate &amp;&amp; historyStartDate.getTime() &gt; 0) {</span>
        const elapsed = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >(Date.now() - historyStartDate.getTime()) / MS_PER_DAY;</span>
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >        totalJourneyDays = Math.max(30, elapsed + daysToExam);</span>
    }
&nbsp;
    // 2. Midpoint Dinâmico: A "reta final" é definida como os últimos 15% do tempo de preparação, com limites sãos.
    const dynamicMidpoint = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >Math.min(60, Math.max(5, totalJourneyDays * 0.15));</span>
    
    // 3. Inclinação Dinâmica (steepness): Garante que a transição de "calmo" para "desespero" ocorra suavemente dentro desse espaço.
    const dynamicSteepness = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >1.8 / dynamicMidpoint; </span>
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    if (daysToExam &gt; dynamicMidpoint * 3) <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >return 1.0; </span></span>// Poupando CPU
&nbsp;
    const x = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >Number(daysToExam);</span>
    const logistic = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >1 / (1 + Math.exp(dynamicSteepness * (x - dynamicMidpoint)));</span>
    const scaled = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >1 + (1.5 * logistic);</span>
&nbsp;
<span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >    return Math.max(1.0, Math.min(2.5, scaled));</span>
}
&nbsp;
function getSRSBoost(history, daysSince, maxScore, cfg, mssdVolatility = null, effectiveN = null) {
    // Agora passa o MSSD e o EffectiveN para o motor de diagnóstico
    const forgettingData = computeForgettingRisk(history, maxScore, null, mssdVolatility, effectiveN);
    
    const retention = forgettingData.retentionPct;
&nbsp;
    if (retention &lt; 30) return { boost: cfg.SRS_BOOST * 2.0, label: "⚠️ Memória Crítica (Risco de Branco)" };
    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (retention &lt; 55) return { boost: cfg.SRS_BOOST * 1.4, label: "🧠 Revisão Necessária (Curva de Esquecimento)" };
    <span class="missing-if-branch" title="if path not taken" >I</span>if (retention &lt; 75) return { boost: cfg.SRS_BOOST * 0.8, label: "🔄 Revisão de Reforço" };
    
    return { boost: 0, label: null };
}
&nbsp;
/**
 * Média Bayesiana para Proficiência Real
 * Ancorada na média global do aluno para evitar penalização artificial de pequenas amostras.
 */
/**
 * Média Bayesiana para Proficiência Real
 * Ancorada na média global do aluno para evitar penalização artificial de pequenas amostras.
 */
export const computeBayesianProficiency = <span class="fstat-no" title="function not covered" >(a</span>certos, total, mediaGlobal = <span class="branch-0 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >0.5,</span> globalTotal = <span class="branch-0 cbranch-no" title="branch not covered" >0)</span> =&gt; {
    // CORREÇÃO: Removido o 'if (total === 0) return 0;' para permitir o Fallback Bayesiano
    
    // OTIMIZAÇÃO: Peso da crença (K) escala com a maturidade do aluno na plataforma.
    // Novatos (globalTotal baixo): K=3. Veteranos (globalTotal alto): K escala até 15.
    const K = <span class="cstat-no" title="statement not covered" >Math.max(3, Math.min(15, Math.log10(globalTotal + 1) * 3));</span>
